properties.displayName: GO-PRD-SENTINEL-043 Multiple signature triggered for the same IP source
properties.description: Detects when an attacker attempts to exploit multiple distinct vulnerabilites within short period of time.
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains"GO-PRD-SENTINEL-043 Multiple signature triggered for the same IP source"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = tostring(A.Address)
| where isnotempty(IP)
| summarize make_list(IP);

let pasyslog = paloaltologs
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where Activity == "THREAT" and ThreatType =="vulnerability"
| where DeviceAction in ("allow","alert")
| where Severity  == "medium" or Severity  == "high" or Severity  == "low"
| extend Signature = ThreatName;


let pacef = CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated > ago (10m)
| where DeviceVendor == "Palo Alto Networks"
| where Activity == "THREAT"  and  DeviceEventClassID == "vulnerability"
| where DeviceAction in ("allow","alert")
| where toint(LogSeverity) > 2
| extend Signature = extract("cat=([^;]+)", 1 , AdditionalExtensions);


let FWLogs= pasyslog | union pacef;

let lookup=toscalar(datatable(ip_range:string) ["64.39.96.0/20","13.115.104.0/24"] | summarize l=make_set(ip_range));
let AllSourceIps = materialize(
FWLogs
| distinct SourceIP
);
let MatchedIps = AllSourceIps
| mv-apply l=lookup to typeof(string) on
(
   where ipv4_is_match (SourceIP, l)
);
FWLogs
| where SourceIP !in (MatchedIps)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| where SourceIP !in (vuln_scanner_IPs)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated), make_set(Signature), make_set(DestinationPort), make_set(SourcePort), SigCount=dcount(Signature), makeset(Computer),make_set(DestinationIP) by SourceIP,MF
| where EndTime - StartTime < 5m
| where SigCount > 5
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = MF
